Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hendersonville for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Santa Land at The Streets of Indian Lake) through December 23 (Santa Land), with the Deck the Hulls boat parade (December 5), the HolidayFest Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting (December 6) and A Merry Castle Christmas at Historic Rock Castle (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
